entries.headline: US aircraft and NATO radar activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. military cargo and surveillance aircraft airborne and NATO radar activity over the North Sea. The post also mentioned a reported Dubai–Tel Aviv flight diversion; the visible text did not identify the military aircraft’s missions.

entries.headline: Taiwan-area air activity reported elevated
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported air activity near Taiwan at nearly four times its usual level. It also reported a commercial flight diversion to Saudi Arabia following a cockpit incident; no link between the two events was stated.

entries.headline: Pacific transports and North Sea radar aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. military transport aircraft over the Pacific region, a NATO radar aircraft over the North Sea, and a surveillance aircraft near the Middle East. The post did not confirm their missions.

entries.headline: West Pacific activity reported above normal
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported military air activity near Taiwan at about 3.4 times its usual level, five heavy transport aircraft airborne, and a U.S. surveillance aircraft over the North Sea. Its post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Transports and radar aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a NATO radar aircraft airborne. It also said a surveillance aircraft had been spotted over the North Sea earlier; no missions were confirmed.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports and no coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one near the Persian Gulf and another near Korea and Japan. It said no coded radio broadcasts had been detected during that hour.

entries.headline: USAF transports and surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four U.S. Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and North Sea, and said a surveillance aircraft had been spotted earlier. The post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Guardian Ukraine briefing relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Guardian Ukraine war briefing saying NATO had condemned Moscow’s nuclear rhetoric as strikes on Kyiv intensified. The post credited @Robertchester; this was third-party reporting.

entries.headline: CBS Iran ceasefire report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a CBS report saying Tehran expected a U.S. response to a ceasefire proposal that President Trump had rejected. The post credited @Robertchester; this was third-party reporting.

entries.headline: USAF transport and surveillance activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and one surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, describing activity as busier than usual. It did not identify callsigns or missions.

entries.headline: Russian bomber crash report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an Independent report saying six people had died after a Russian bomber crashed during a training exercise. The post credited @Robertchester; this was third-party reporting.

entries.headline: Nuclear command and transport aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force nuclear command aircraft, three heavy transport aircraft and one reconnaissance aircraft airborne over the United States, and described activity as elevated. The post did not identify callsigns or purpose.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NATO02 E3TF departure at Albacete
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported E3TF callsign NATO02 off the ground at Albacete, Spain. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: BOE36 E737 departure at Lossiemouth
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported E737 callsign BOE36 off the ground at Lossiemouth, United Kingdom. The alert did not establish its operator, destination or mission.

entries.headline: F-16 identification system report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Defence Blog report about clearance for BAE Systems’ AN/APX-127(V)1 identification system for F-16 aircraft. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: F/A-XX contract report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Defence Blog report saying Boeing had beaten Northrop Grumman for a U.S. Navy F/A-XX fighter contract. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: Super Hornet production report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Defence Blog report saying the U.S. Navy was paying Boeing to plan the shutdown of F/A-18E/F and EA-18G production lines. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: Boeing F/A-XX analysis shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Breaking Defense analysis of what Boeing’s F/A-XX contract win could mean for the company and its future work. This was third-party analysis, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: GURNY01 P-8 departure at Lossiemouth
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported P-8 callsign GURNY01 off the ground at Lossiemouth, United Kingdom. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: E3TF departure at Urasoe
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported an E3TF aircraft off the ground at Urasoe, Japan. The alert did not show a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure near Narasingapuram
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground near Narasingapuram, India. The alert did not show a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: F/A-XX rendering report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked TWZ article about Boeing’s F/A-XX fighter rendering. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: P-8 reported on the ground at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 on the ground at Burton, Australia. The alert shows the label TRDT but does not confirm the aircraft’s mission, destination or reason for being there.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Oak Harbor, United States. The alert gives no callsign and does not confirm the aircraft’s destination or mission.
